create_python_parser: create a PythonParser instance to parse CSV data from a file buffer or nested list into a DataFrame
read_csv_data: read CSV file content and return an index, columns, and column data mapping as a tuple
convert_data_types: convert parsed column data to proper numpy arrays with NA handling, type inference, and dtype casting
parse_fixed_width_fields: parse fixed-width field files into DataFrames using detected column specifications
infer_column_headers: infer column headers from file lines supporting multi-index columns and usecols filtering
handle_bad_lines: handle malformed CSV rows by raising errors, emitting warnings, or applying a callback function
validate_skipfooter: validate the skipfooter parameter is a non-negative integer before CSV parsing
